name: application-photo-grid-selectable
title: Photo Grid Selectable
description: Multi-select photo grid where a count bar appears only when at least one photo is selected, with the count and Clear action derived from the same real selection set.
useWhen: Letting a user multi-select photos for a bulk action (delete, share, add to album) from a dense grid.
The selection count and a Clear-selection action should stay in sync with which tiles are actually checked.
Photos are browsed in a grid rather than viewed one at a time in a lightbox.
avoidWhen: You need a full-screen single-photo viewer with next/prev navigation — use `image-gallery-lightbox` for that viewing pattern instead.
Only a single photo can ever be selected — a simpler radio-style grid is enough.
There's no bulk action to take on the selection — a plain (non-selectable) grid is enough.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width grid (max-w-md) at a 3-column layout; tiles stay square via aspect-square regardless of container width.
accessibility: Each tile is a real role="button" with aria-pressed reflecting selection state and a descriptive aria-label, and is keyboard-operable via Enter/Space.
Selection is conveyed by both a checkmark badge and a ring outline together, never by a subtle color change alone.
The count bar and its Clear action only render when the underlying selection set is non-empty, so they can never show a stale count.

variants.title: Photo Grid Selectable
variants.description: 6-photo grid (gradient placeholders) with a count bar that appears once a photo is selected and a working Clear action.
accessibility: Count bar visibility, selected count, and per-tile checkmark/ring are all derived from the same selection set, verified interactively.

variants.title: Photo Grid Selectable (Dark)
variants.description: Photo grid selectable adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Count bar and ring colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
